source.author: lucan
source.text: Ut procul immensam campo consurgere nubem, Ardentesque acies percussis sole corusco Conspexit telis, Socii, decurrite, dixit, fluminis ad ripas, undaeque immergite pontem: Et tu montanis totus nunc fontibus exi, Atque omnes trahe, gurges, aquas ut spumeus alnos, Discussa compage, feras.
source.text_original: Ut procul immensam campo consurgere nubem, / Ardentesque acies percussis sole corusco / Conspexit telis, Socii, decurrite, dixit, / fluminis ad ripas, undaeque immergite pontem: / Et tu montanis totus nunc fontibus exi, / Atque omnes trahe, gurges, aquas ut spumeus alnos, / Discussa compage, feras.
source.text_english: When he saw from afar, in the plain, a huge cloud rising and ranks blazing as the sun flashed on their weapons, he said, Socii, run down to the banks of the river, and plunge the bridge into the waters. And you too, now pour out wholly from your mountain springs, and draw together all your waters, torrent, so that, with the structure shattered, you may carry off the alders, foam-covered.

reuse.text_english: The ship, driven on together, goes; mothers stand on the shore and, with their eyes, follow the bright sails and the shields of the men, struck by the sun, until the sea, now higher than the trees, and the vast air carried the ship away from the viewers.
